subject.title: Add tree view command to visualize active agents

question: Should OpenClaw add a broad active-agent tree command/view now, and if so should it live as `openclaw tree`, under `openclaw sessions`, in the TUI, or be deferred behind session-chain/subagent-depth work?
rationale: The missing source surface is clear, but adding it creates a new public CLI/TUI/API contract and overlaps with narrower recursive subagent-listing and session-chain tracking issues.

options.title: Add narrow sessions tree
options.body: Approve a read-only hierarchy MVP over existing session/subagent lineage with text and JSON output, while deferring watch mode and CPU/RSS metrics.

options.title: Fold into canonical chain work
options.body: Keep this issue open but make it depend on the session-chain or recursive subagent-listing design before adding a separate public command.

options.title: Decline broad tree surface
options.body: Close the request as outside current core direction and document existing flat sessions/subagents inspection surfaces instead.

recommendation.title: Add narrow sessions tree
recommendation.body: Approve a read-only hierarchy MVP over existing session/subagent lineage with text and JSON output, while deferring watch mode and CPU/RSS metrics.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-code routing candidate from blame and related session-chain triage, and the decision is about public CLI/Gateway product surface.
